description: Audit third-party Agent Skills, plugins, and MCP tool definitions for security risk before installation: prompt injection, hidden or invisible instructions, credential access, exfiltration, dangerous shell, over-broad triggers, and supply-chain drift. Use when reviewing an external skill repository or package, deciding whether to install or update a skill, or writing an audit report with evidence and severity. Do not use to review your own application's source code (use security-code-review), to harden CI workflows (use github-actions-security), or to build an MCP server (use mcp-server-development). A clean scan is never proof of safety.
